items.text:
oṁ  prātara-gnim prātari-ndram̐ havāmahe
prātar mitrā varuṇā prātara-śvinā ।
prātar bhagam pūṣaṇam brahmaṇaspatim
prātas somamu-ta rudram̐ huvema ॥1॥

translation.en: At dawn we invoke Agni, at dawn Indra, at dawn Mitra and Varuṇa, at dawn the Aśvins. At dawn Bhaga, the deity of fortune, Pūṣan, Brahmaṇaspati, at dawn we invoke Soma, and also Rudra.

entries.meaning: at dawn, early in the morning

items.text:
prātar jitam bhagamu-gram̐ huvema
vayam putrama-diter yo vidhartā ।
ādhraś cid yam manyamānas turaś cid
rājā cid yam bhagam bhakṣī-tyā-ha ॥2॥

translation.en: At dawn we invoke the victorious, fierce Bhaga, we call upon the son of Aditi, who is the upholder. Even the lowly one who thinks of him, even the swift one, even the king says: "Let me enjoy Bhaga!"

entries.meaning: at dawn, early in the morning

entries.note: 'bhakṣi iti āha': bhakṣ (partake) + āha (says); Vedic idiom, analysis best-effort

items.text:
bhaga praṇetar bhaga satyarādho
bhage-mān dhiyamu-dava dadan naḥ ।
bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhira-śvair
bhaga pra nṛbhir nṛvantas syāma ॥3॥

translation.en: Bhaga the leader, Bhaga the giver of true wealth, Bhaga, grant us protection of our consciousness. Bhaga, multiply our cattle and horses, Bhaga, may we be heroic among heroes.

entries.meaning: of true bounty, whose gifts are true

items.text:
ute-dānīm bhagavantas syāmo-
ta prapitva  uta madhye  ahnām । anhām
uto-ditā maghavanth sūryasya
vayan devānām̐ sumatau syāma ॥4॥

translation.en: And now may we be possessors of Bhaga, and at evening, and in the middle of the days, and at the rising of the bountiful Sun, may we be in the good favour of the gods.

items.text:
bhaga  eva bhagavām̐  astu devās
tena vayam bhagavantas syāma ।
tan tvā bhaga sarva  ij johavīmi
sa no bhaga pura  etā bhave-ha ॥5॥

translation.en: May Bhaga alone be the fortunate, o gods, by that may we be possessors of Bhaga. That you, O Bhaga, of all indeed I call upon repeatedly, may he become foremost for us here.

items.text:
samadhvarāyo-ṣaso namanta
dadhikrāve-va śucaye padāya ।
arvācīnaṁ vasu vidam bhagan no
rathami-vā-śvā vājina  āvahantu ॥6॥

translation.en: For the well-performed sacrifice the Dawns bow, like the divine horse Dadhikrāvan to the radiant path. Towards us, may the swift horses bring here Bhaga the wealth-finder, like a chariot.

items.text:
aśvāvatīr gomatīr na  uṣāso
vīravatīs sadamu-cchantu bhadrāḥ ।
ghṛtan duhānā viśvataḥ prapīnā
yūyam pāta svastibhis sadā naḥ ॥7॥

translation.en: May the dawns, rich in horses, rich in cattle, rich in heroes, and always auspicious shine for us. May all of you who yield ghee, overflowing from all sides, always protect us with auspicious blessings. taittirīya āraṇyaka ekāgnikāṇḍa 2.6., āpastamba mantrapāṭha 2.6.12

items.text:
yo mā'gne bhāginam̐ santama-thā-bhāgañ cikīrṣati । 
abhāgama-gne taṅ kuru māma-gne bhāginaṅ kuru ॥8॥

translation.en: O Agni, whoever wishes to deprive me, the fortunate one, make him dispossessed, o Agni! Make me fortunate, o Agni!

subtitle: Hymn for fortune and the awakening of dawn
title: bhāgya sūktam
